A full-body costume reference portrait of a beautiful woman in traditional ancient attire, depicted from head to toe in a neutral standing pose, evenly lit with flat uniform lighting and no directional light source. 8-head proportion. Looking directly at the camera with a composed expression, standing naturally with both arms resting gently at her sides. Fully clothed from neck to feet.

Her hair is styled into an elegant updo with intricate braids and adorned with delicate hairpins featuring floral motifs. She is dressed in a flowing hanfu-style robe, with wide sleeves and a layered design. The outer robe is made of soft, lightweight fabric in pastel tones, featuring subtle embroidered patterns of flowers and vines. Beneath the outer robe, a contrasting inner layer with a high collar and fine decorative trims is visible. A silk sash cinches the waist, tied into a neat bow at the back. The lower garment is a long pleated skirt that drapes gracefully to the floor. She wears embroidered silk shoes with floral patterns.

Her accessories include delicate jade earrings, a fine silver necklace with a small pendant, and an ornamental bracelet on one wrist. Her face is framed by a few loose strands of hair, enhancing her gentle and dignified appearance.

Solid white background, free from any shadows, gradients, textures, patterns, ground lines, text, or seals. High detail, professional quality, sharp rendering.
